Workflows we build

What changes, workflow by workflow.

  • LP and investor onboarding

    Juniper Square · Carta · Allvue · Salesforce
    Today
    Subscription documents come back as scanned PDFs, incomplete, and are keyed into fund admin by hand.
    What we build
    One guided flow for subscription agreements, accreditation, W-9 or W-8BEN and KYC, with e-signature. Completed data goes to your fund administrator and CRM in the format they need.

  • Deal-flow triage and portfolio KPI collection

    DealCloud · Salesforce · Excel
    Today
    Inbound decks pile up, and portfolio metrics are chased by email each month.
    What we build
    Inbound opportunities summarized against your investment criteria, with sources shown. Portfolio companies submit KPIs through a structured form, and the results flow to your pipeline and reporting.

  • Quarterly LP letters and capital account statements

    Allvue · Carta · Addepar · Juniper Square
    Today
    The same figures are copied into letters and statements every quarter.
    What we build
    Drafts generated from approved numbers in your template and voice. Your team reviews and releases, and investors receive them through the portal.

  • IPS and mandate compliance checks

    Addepar · Orion · custodial data
    Today
    Limits are checked by hand against statements.
    What we build
    Holdings and activity checked against each policy's limits on a schedule. Exceptions go to a review queue, and every decision is recorded.

  • Client intake and CRM sync for advisory firms

    Redtail · Wealthbox · Salesforce Financial Services Cloud
    Today
    New-client paperwork is re-typed into the CRM field by field.
    What we build
    The system we built for Team Financial Strategies: digital intake, CRM sync and signed PDFs, which took onboarding from 45 minutes to under 5.
    More for advisory firms
How it works

Extraction you can check, with a person in the loop.

Every value carries its source. Anything that does not reconcile is held for review.

  1. Documents inUploads, email attachments, system exports.
  2. ExtractFields pulled into a fixed structure, with the source page recorded.
  3. ReviewValidation rules run. A person confirms or corrects what is flagged.
  4. System of recordApproved data lands in your model, CRM, core or fund-admin system.
  5. ReportMemos, statements and audit trails generated from approved data.

Security

How your data is handled.

Security and data handling

  • Investor and client records stay in your systems. We do not keep a copy of investor PII on MonkFlow infrastructure.

  • Role-based access for investor relations, finance, compliance and outside investors.

  • A complete audit trail of every submission, sync, signature and approval.

  • Private deployment and zero-retention model configurations for anything that touches AI.

Questions

What firms ask us first.

Do we have to change fund administrators or CRMs?

No. We build around what you run today and hand data to your administrator in the format they already accept.

Who reviews AI-drafted letters and summaries?

Your team. Drafts are generated from approved numbers and go through your normal review before anything is released to an investor.

Do you work with RIAs as well as funds?

Yes. Our named client, Team Financial Strategies, is a four-advisor wealth management firm. There is a separate page for advisory firms with more detail.

What does an engagement cost?

It depends on the workflow, the systems involved and how much review tooling your team needs. Every engagement is scoped individually, and you see a written scope and quote before any build work starts.

Not sure where to start? Start with a workflow audit.

We map one workflow and the systems around it, rank the automation opportunities, and write up scope and data handling. You decide what, if anything, to build.

Bring us your worst manual workflow.

A working session is 20 minutes with the engineer who would build it. Walk through the process, and leave with a straight answer on whether it is worth automating.
